simpleschematics.tip.tab.library: Everything you have saved or dropped into the folder.
simpleschematics.tip.tab.placements: The builds you have put down in this world.
simpleschematics.tip.place: Puts it on your crosshair. Point where you want it and right click to drop it.
simpleschematics.tip.place.none: Pick a schematic on the left first.
simpleschematics.tip.place.broken: This file could not be read, so there is nothing to place.
simpleschematics.tip.resource_list: Opens the full list of what this build needs.
simpleschematics.tip.resource_list.none: Pick a schematic on the left first.
simpleschematics.tip.resource_list.broke: This file could not be read, so its materials are unknown.
simpleschematics.tip.convert: Rewrites this Litematic as a native file, which loads faster.
simpleschematics.tip.convert.none: Pick a schematic on the left first.
simpleschematics.tip.convert.native: This is already a native file, so there is nothing to convert.
simpleschematics.tip.delete: Deletes the file from your schematics folder for good.
simpleschematics.tip.delete.none: Pick a schematic on the left first.
simpleschematics.tip.delete.placement: Removes this placement. The schematic file is left alone.
simpleschematics.tip.open_folder: Opens your schematics folder in a file browser.
simpleschematics.tip.reset: Clears everything you have ticked off or corrected by hand.
simpleschematics.tip.reset.none: Nothing has been ticked off or corrected yet.
simpleschematics.tip.count_placed: Blocks already standing correctly in the placement come off what is still needed. Only loaded chunks can be checked, so a distant build reads as untouched until you have been near it.
simpleschematics.tip.rebuild: Throws away the cached hologram geometry and builds it again.
simpleschematics.feedback.need_both_corn: Set Both Corners First, Right Click Then Left Click
simpleschematics.feedback.bank_needs_pla: Select a Placement First, Then the Chest Can Feed It
simpleschematics.gui.placements_hint: Right click a row to show or hide that build.
key.simpleschematics.toggle_box: Hold Menu: Show or Hide the Outline Box
simpleschematics.tip.live.mod: Switches the whole mod on or off. Hold Menu and press T to do it from in game.
simpleschematics.tip.live.mode: Scan captures a build from the world, Build puts one down. Hold Ctrl and scroll to swap in game.
simpleschematics.tip.live.holograms: Hides every hologram without switching the mod off. Hold Menu and press R.
simpleschematics.tip.live.resource_list: Shows the corner list of what this build still needs. Hold Menu and press O.
Select a placement, or pick up a schematic, so the list has something to follow.
simpleschematics.tip.live.highlight: Outlines the blocks that are wrong or in the way while you are in Build mode. Hold Menu and press H.
simpleschematics.tip.menu_key: On, nothing else bound to this key responds to it, which is what stops Menu and T also opening chat. Off, a minimap on the same key works again, but the chords stop being reliable, so rebind the menu key under Controls as well.
simpleschematics.tip.shader_pack: Iris and Oculus replace the level render and ignore this mod's own shader, which leaves the holograms invisible. Auto uses a plain render type whenever a pack is loaded, at the cost of the near fade and the distance fade.
simpleschematics.tip.shader_pack.none: No shader mod is installed, so this changes nothing. It matters once Iris or Oculus is running a pack, because they ignore this mod's own shader and the holograms would otherwise be invisible.
